message.content:
Below is a quick‑look at the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday on a Monday or Friday (or a holiday observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend).  The list below is based on the federal holidays that apply nationwide; provincial‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. Alberta) are omitted for brevity.

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | **Monday, Feb 20** | **Feb 18 – 20** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat 18‑Sun 19 + Mon 20). |
| 2 | **Good Friday** | **Friday, Apr 7** | **Apr 7 – 9** | Friday + weekend (Sat 8‑Sun 9). |
| 3 | **Victoria Day** | **Monday, May 22** | **May 20 – 22** | Sat 20‑Sun 21 + Mon 22. |
| 4 | **Canada Day** (observed) | **Monday, Jul 3** (observed for Sat 1) | **Jul 1 – 3** | Sat 1‑Sun 2 + Mon 3. |
| 5 | **Labour Day** | **Monday, Sep 4** | **Sep 2 – 4** | Sat 2‑Sun 3 + Mon 4. |
| 6 | **Thanksgiving** | **Monday, Oct 9** | **Oct 7 – 9** | Sat 7‑Sun 8 + Mon 9. |
| 7 | **Remembrance Day** (observed) | **Monday, Nov 13** (observed for Sat 11) | **Nov 11 – 13** | Sat 11‑Sun 12 + Mon 13. |
| 8 | **Christmas** | **Monday, Dec 25** | **Dec 23 – 25** | Sat 23‑Sun 24 + Mon 25. |
| 9 | **New Year’s Day** (observed) | **Monday, Jan 2** (observed for Sun 1) | **Dec 30 – Jan 2** | Dec 30‑31 + Mon 2 (cross‑year). |

### Quick Summary

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| February | Feb 18 – 20 | Family Day |
| April | Apr 7 – 9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20 – 22 | Victoria Day |
| July | Jul 1 – 3 | Canada Day (observed) |
| September | Sep 2 – 4 | Labour Day |
| October | Oct 7 – 9 | Thanksgiving |
| November | Nov 11 – 13 | Remembrance Day (observed) |
| December | Dec 23 – 25 | Christmas |
| January (cross‑year) | Dec 30 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day (observed) |

> **Tip for your holiday‑planning app:**  
> If you want to support provincial variations (e.g., Family Day on different dates in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.), you’ll need to pull province‑specific holiday calendars. The federal list above covers the nationwide long weekends that most Canadians would have taken advantage of in 2023.
